!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1	"6x10E6 cells were fixed with 1% formaldehyde in culture medium for 10 min at room temperature followed by quenching with 0.1 M glycine for 5 min. The cells were washed twice with ice-cold PBS and lysed in 0.5 ml of lysis buffer (0.25% SDS, 8 mM EDTA, 50 mM HEPES pH7.5 plus 0.2 mM DTT, 0.5 MM PMSF, 0.2mM Na3VO4) for 15 min on ice before crosslinked chromatin was sheared to an average size of 500-bp by ten 10-second pulses at 60% output using a Branson Digital Sonifier 450 (Branson Ultrasonics). The lysates were then centrifuged to remove cell debris and diluted with 4-vol of ChIPbuffer (1% Triton X-100, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 180 mM KCl plus protease inhibitors) and pre-cleared with 20 µl protein A/G sepharose beads (pre-absorbed with salmon sperm DNA and BSA) for 1 h at 4C. The chromatin supernatant was then incubated overnight with 5 µg of purified antibody at 4°C. After incubation with protein A/G sepharose beads (40 µl) for 2h at 4°C, the immune complexes were collected by centrifugation and washed with the following buffers each for 10 min at 4°C; washing buffer (145 mM KCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 0.05% SDS), high-salt buffer (washing plus 0.3M KCl), LiCl buffer (250 mM LiCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 0.2% Na deoxycholate, 1% NP40), and 2x TE (20 mM Tris pH8, 2 mM EDTA). The protein-DNA complexes were eluted from the beads in 400 µl elution buffer (1% SDS, 10mM Tris pH 8) at 50°C for 1 h followed by O/N incubation at 65°C and ProteinaseK digestion at 45 °C. Genomic DNA was isolated from the precipitated material by phenol/chloroform extraction, ethanol precipitation, RNAse digestion, and purification by QIAquick minicolumns (Quiagen). Purified genomic DNA was amplified by WGA reamplification kit (Sigma)." !Sample_extract_protocol_ch2	"6x10E6 cells were fixed with 1% formaldehyde in culture medium for 10 min at room temperature followed by quenching with 0.1 M glycine for 5 min. The cells were washed twice with ice-cold PBS and lysed in 0.5 ml of lysis buffer (0.25% SDS, 8 mM EDTA, 50 mM HEPES pH7.5 plus 0.2 mM DTT, 0.5 MM PMSF, 0.2mM Na3VO4) for 15 min on ice before crosslinked chromatin was sheared to an average size of 500-bp by ten 10-second pulses at 60% output using a Branson Digital Sonifier 450 (Branson Ultrasonics). The lysates were then centrifuged to remove cell debris and diluted with 4-vol of ChIPbuffer (1% Triton X-100, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 180 mM KCl plus protease inhibitors) and pre-cleared with 20 µl protein A/G sepharose beads (pre-absorbed with salmon sperm DNA and BSA) for 1 h at 4C. The chromatin supernatant was then incubated overnight with 5 µg of purified antibody at 4°C. After incubation with protein A/G sepharose beads (40 µl) for 2h at 4°C, the immune complexes were collected by centrifugation and washed with the following buffers each for 10 min at 4°C; washing buffer (145 mM KCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 0.05% SDS), high-salt buffer (washing plus 0.3M KCl), LiCl buffer (250 mM LiCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 0.2% Na deoxycholate, 1% NP40), and 2x TE (20 mM Tris pH8, 2 mM EDTA). The protein-DNA complexes were eluted from the beads in 400 µl elution buffer (1% SDS, 10mM Tris pH 8) at 50°C for 1 h followed by O/N incubation at 65°C and ProteinaseK digestion at 45 °C. Genomic DNA was isolated from the precipitated material by phenol/chloroform extraction, ethanol precipitation, RNAse digestion, and purification by QIAquick minicolumns (Quiagen). Purified genomic DNA was amplified by WGA reamplification kit (Sigma)."
